scope.coverage_rule: Whole published sitemap snapshot catalogued; selected relevant pages/sections reviewed. Retrieved fulltext is not automatically marked read.

read_status_meanings.fulltext_read: The complete individual text or index was read, not just its title.
read_status_meanings.relevant_sections_reviewed: Full text acquired; named subject-specific sections examined, not every paragraph independently reviewed.
read_status_meanings.index_only: URL/title acquired from sitemap; full individual page not reviewed.
read_status_meanings.fulltext_retrieved_not_reviewed: Included in downloaded bulk but no complete semantic reading claimed.
read_status_meanings.metadata_fields_verified: Official npm name/version/engines/peers/license metadata examined; package code not executed or audited.
read_status_meanings.open_failed_url: HTTP error; no page text claimed. Corrected alternatives, where found, are separate source records.

recommended_minimal_install_plan.node: Project now declares22.x; SDK packages require>=22; verify selected platform runtime/minor for optional Nitro.
recommended_minimal_install_plan.incompatible_combination: Do not mix current AI7 with legacy @workflow/ai5.0.3 (peer ai^6).

minimal_supported_contract.function_location: api/index.ts or api/chat.ts relative to selected Vercel project root
minimal_supported_contract.function_signature: export default { async fetch(request: Request): Promise<Response> { /* validate method/session/owner/CSRF/body/budget, then return stream Response */ } };
minimal_supported_contract.alternative: Named HTTP method exports are documented; Nitro uses its own defineEventHandler wrapper and explicit Vite plugin.
minimal_supported_contract.agent_api: ToolLoopAgent with approved server model/tools and explicit loop, retry, timeout, output-token and telemetry bounds.
important_options: maxRetries:0 for non-repeatable paid model calls
omit streamRetries and do not request retry from onError when ambiguous paid outcomes require reconciliation
onUIMessageStepEnd can await idempotent intermediate persistence

capability_findings.finding: Vercel supports root api/index.ts exporting default { fetch(request: Request): Response | Promise<Response> }; named HTTP method exports are an alternative. Vite guide recommends Nitro for broader backend integration.

useChat from @ai-sdk/react plus DefaultChatTransport from ai posts to /api/chat and consumes UIMessage streams; createAgentUIStreamResponse({agent,uiMessages,...}) is server-only. No custom transport or Next.js migration is needed for the basic path.

ToolLoopAgent+tool(inputSchema,execute), agent toolApproval policies and isStepCount exist. Default loop is 20 steps; no arbitrary shell/admin/customer-tool bridge is required. Tool approval UI is not server authorization.

Transport can carry cookies/dynamic auth headers. Persistence guide explicitly excludes authorization/error handling and uses illustrative files. Production must bind chat/run to verified actor/tenant and persist trusted server history in durable storage. Vercel OIDC authenticates a deployment/workload to Gateway, not the end user.

Current AI7 package is @ai-sdk/workflow2.0.85, depends exactly on ai7.0.153 and works with workflow5.2.3. Legacy @workflow/ai5.0.3 requires ai^6. Vite Workflow guide uses nitro/vite+workflow/vite plugins; Nitro latest3.0.260903-beta is explicitly a beta. WorkflowChatTransport supports reconnect, not automatic business-level idempotency.

Vercel Sandbox provides Firecracker isolation; firewall default is allow-all. deny-all or reviewed destination policies and credential brokering must be explicit. Passing experimental_sandbox does not itself sandbox a tool; the tool must delegate operations to it. Not required for simple quote/booking tools.

Current AI7 telemetry documentation states opt-out, with inputs and outputs recorded by default. telemetry:{isEnabled:false} disables per-call telemetry; absent global registration is not equivalent. Gateway logs/costs and Vercel platform monitoring are separate services/retention.

streamText maxRetries defaults to2. Omit streamRetries to disable its complete stream retry path; zero still permits callback-directed retry. Workflow steps default to3 retries. Gateway BYOK paid-tier system-credential fallback can consume credits. None of these defaults guarantees idempotency or a per-tenant spend ceiling.

Public Gateway catalog contains exact DeepSeek1017 but advertises regions:[us]. An EU-only claim for this exact Gateway route is unsupported. No region means global; unsupported region fails rather than downgrades. Workflow run data can be pinned but hook records and observability metadata have distinct regional behavior.

cost_and_retention_limits.functions: Current Fluid compute guide: Hobby300s max; Pro/Enterprise800s generally available and1800s beta with prerequisites. Streaming counts toward duration; request/response payload limit4.5MB. This is provider documentation, not chosen project configuration.
cost_and_retention_limits.gateway: Current documentation says no token markup/no Gateway BYOK fee, but BYOK is paid tier, requires purchased credits and defaults to system-credential fallback on failed own keys. Payment processing/add-on/drain charges may apply.
cost_and_retention_limits.workflow: Events/data-written/data-retained usage charges and Function compute are separate. Durable waits do not mean all workflow storage/execution is free.
cost_and_retention_limits.workflow_retention: Payload read retention and maximum deletion deadline are distinct; logs/traces/own databases follow their own rules. No API for deleting already-finished individual runs is documented. Zero retention is experimental for new runs; metadata remains.
cost_and_retention_limits.sandbox: Active CPU, allocated memory while waiting, storage/snapshot/network and plan limits must be checked; isolation is not a free/unlimited shell service.

recommended_route.first_increment: Keep native React/Vite interface. Reuse official useChat/DefaultChatTransport and a same-origin Vercel Node fetch Function; instantiate exact-model OpenRouter provider on server. Preserve local structured tools and their backend authorization/state semantics.
recommended_route.second_increment: Persist tenant-owned UI messages/trusted server history and durable request IDs; authenticate sessions independently from Gateway OIDC. Test abort, disconnect, restart and owner isolation.
recommended_route.durable_increment: Only when required, adopt documented Nitro+Workflow Vite setup and current @ai-sdk/workflow/WorkflowChatTransport; bind step idempotency, approvals, retention and region before real business effects.
recommended_route.sandbox_increment: Only for explicitly needed untrusted-code execution, with restricted network and secret brokering; not a default public chat tool.
not_required: Chat SDK for nonexistent Slack/Teams channels
Vercel Gateway in front of an already-requested direct OpenRouter route

runtime_gates_open: No live SDK/provider call performed by this review.
Verify exact OpenRouter reasoning high and usage/cost wire contract after installation; no silently dropped parameters.
Private business membership and tenant enforcement are not provided by useChat, Clerk UI or Vercel OIDC.
Real project plan, billing, functions duration/region, Gateway keys, Workflow permissions/retention and Sandbox egress remain account-specific.
No complete production persistence/migration/recovery or side-effect idempotency proof is established by documentation.
Failed guessed documentation paths are retained as failures, not treated as missing platform features.
